s1.text: Step 1. Please approve the phone menu. The bar is one row: the logo and the Menu button. The opened menu holds the links, groups that open in place one at a time, the language row, the utility links and the one button. Boards 1.1 to 1.8 are light and English. The last row is the fullest state in dark and in Arabic.

t2.text: Step 2: the utility row and the language switcher

s2.text: Step 2. Please approve the row above the bar (utility links and the language), the mega panel opening under the bar, and the two forms of the language switcher: a menu and a list.

t3.text: Step 3: search in the header and the phone action bar

s3.text: Step 3. Please approve search in the bar (closed, open, typing) and the bar fixed to the foot of a phone screen that holds the one call to action.
